name: Alert
looksLike: wide message strip with a warning
notice that stays above the form
colored box explaining an error on the page
definition: A visible message that stays in the page to explain a problem, warning, or update, often near the content it concerns.

notConfusedWith.difference: Appears briefly and often disappears automatically; an alert usually stays until resolved or dismissed.

prompts.short: Add an alert with a clear message that stays visible until resolved.
prompts.detailed: Add a persistent alert near the affected content with a clear heading and helpful next step. Use text as well as color. Reserve role="alert" for urgent dynamic messages; use role="status" for routine updates and a normal section for static notices. Do not move focus or auto-dismiss essential information.

html: Uploads will be unavailable tonight from 10 to 11 PM. Save your work before then.
<!-- For urgent dynamically inserted errors, use role="alert"; routine updates use role="status". -->
vue: Uploads will be unavailable tonight from 10 to 11 PM. Save your work before then.
